title: Generic Fp prime FieldVec batch dispatch (Solinas-friendly)
description:
## Current

`gfp::FieldVec` add/sub/mul currently dispatches to AVX2 batch kernels only for `Fp<65537>` and `Fp<2^31-1>`. All other primes (including the 64-bit primes used by `gfpn` tower extensions) fall through to scalar element-wise loops in `crates/gf2-core/src/gfp/simd_ops.rs` and the callers in `gfpn/`.

## Fix

Extend the `SimdVecOps` SoA path with a generic Solinas-friendly reducer template that handles any prime fitting the form (lazy reduction + final correction). Existing Mersenne and Fermat specialisations stay; everything else routes through the new generic SIMD path before the scalar fallback.

## PPC steps

V0 baseline (`fp_specialized` + `fieldvec_dot_product` benches with a non-Mersenne, non-Fermat prime) → V3 generic SIMD reducer → asm verify.

## Per-kernel execution protocol

Same as A1.

## Depends on

I1, I2, I3, I4.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Existing Mersenne/Fermat specialisations remain bit-exact and at least as fast.
- [hard] Generic path bit-exact against scalar for every prime in the existing `proofs/` test suite.
- [hard] Word-boundary `#[test]`s for batch sizes.
- [aspirational] ≥1.5× geomean over scalar fallback for at least one non-special prime at the design batch size.
